description: Example: finds finished downloads seeded longer than you set and proposes removing them; nothing is removed without your yes.

proposal.why: They finished downloading and have been seeding for {{days}} days or more.

card.title: Finished downloads seeded {{days}}+ days
card.empty: Nothing has been seeding that long.

settings.seeded_days_help: Counted from when the download finished; 0 means as soon as it has finished.
settings.delete_files_help: Off: only the torrent is removed; its files stay, and the library keeps its own links.
settings.kind_help: Limit the cleanup to one kind of title.
